title: inventory-service request timeouts due to thread pool exhaustion
summary: inventory-service began timing out on the majority of requests after a downstream dependency became slow. Because calls to that dependency were synchronous and blocking, the service's thread pool filled with threads waiting on it, starving unrelated requests.
root_cause: Calls to the slow downstream dependency had no timeout configured, so a single slow dependency could exhaust the entire thread pool indefinitely.
fix: Added an explicit timeout and circuit breaker around the downstream call, so a slow dependency degrades gracefully instead of exhausting shared resources.
